title: Monday Daily Practice
subtitle: Class day B7: warm-up with the Lesson 7 words
source: Foundation 11 lesson plan, week 5 (B7 Other people's habits, B8 Putting it all together + Phase A test), Mon 9 Nov (class day B7)
intro: Class day. This is a 15-minute warm-up only. Do not submit. Bring your notes to class tonight.

steps.title: Step 1 · Guess the meaning
steps.instructions: These are tonight's new words. Choose the best meaning. It is OK to guess.

options.A: a person who likes to stay awake late at night
options.B: a person who works on a farm
options.C: a person who is afraid of the dark

options.A: a person who eats a lot in the morning
options.B: a person who gets up very early

options.A: feel very tired and stressed from too much work

options.B: cannot stop using or doing something

steps.title: Step 2 · Say it aloud
steps.instructions: Say the 10 new words and the 3 sentences aloud. You do not need to send it today.
lines: be a night owl · be an early bird · stay up late · skip (breakfast) · recycle · mow the lawn · meditate · burn out · be addicted to · stay in bed
steps.note: Teacher listens for the -s ending in goes and the stress: MED-i-tate, RE-cy-cle, ad-DIC-ted.
